Deadlift + Push Press (mandatory day)
notes: Warm-up: 8-10 min easy row/bike + barbell-only ramp-up sets before the Deadlift block. Per R26, keep >=48h from any other heavy hinge or heavy overhead-press session; treat the next day as lower-intensity/rest (R21).

name: Bench Press strength day
notes: Warm-up: 8-10 min general + bar-only bench ramp-up sets.

name: Weighted Pull-up strength day
notes: Warm-up: 8-10 min general + dead-hang/scap-pull activation.

name: Power Clean + Front Squat (olympic power day)
notes: Warm-up: 8-10 min general + empty-bar clean pulls/front-rack mobility. Power block goes first per R7/R24 (peak neural precision before fatigue).

name: Zone 2 Row (monthly slog)
notes: Warm-up is built into the first 5 min of the row at an easy pace.

name: Norwegian 4x4 Bike Intervals
notes: Warm-up: 10 min easy bike before round 1. 3 min active recovery pedal between rounds.

name: True Tabata Bike Protocol
notes: Warm-up: 5-8 min easy bike. Single movement only, supramaximal intensity -- this is the actual validated Tabata protocol (R12), unlike the pool's other mixed-movement 20/10 circuits.

name: Back Squat 5x5 + press/row accessory
notes: Classic linear-progression squat day (R1-R3): 5x5 at RPE 8 with 3 min rest, then an upper-body accessory superset (R10/R11: 8-12 reps, 90 s rest) so the conditioning stays short and moderate (R20). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Front Squat 4x6 + RDL/ring row accessory
notes: Front squat at the top of the strength rep range (R1: 4-6 reps), a hinge accessory kept sub-maximal (R11), and an 8 min moderate AMRAP finisher (R16, R20). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Back Squat heavy 5x3 (DUP heavy day)
notes: The heavy day of a daily-undulating wave (R34/R35): triples at ~85-90% with 4 min rest (R3). Sled and bike keep the finisher joint-friendly after heavy squats. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Back Squat 4x8 volume day
notes: The volume day of the wave: 8s for the strength-hypertrophy overlap (R1, R2), shorter rest because the load is lighter (R3). Battle-rope 20/10 finisher is a conditioning circuit, not the validated Tabata protocol (R12). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Deadlift heavy 5x3 + pull-up/KB press
notes: Heavy hinge day (R1, R3, R5-style triples). Keep >=48 h from the mandatory deadlift + push press day (R21, R26); the pattern gate enforces this. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Deadlift 4x6 + bench/ring row accessory
notes: Deadlift at 6s (top of R1's strength range) paired with a push/pull accessory superset so no second hinge movement stacks on the main lift (R21). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Sumo Deadlift 5x5 + press/row accessory
notes: Sumo variant for hinge-pattern variety at the same 5x5 / 3 min prescription (R1-R3). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Bench Press heavy 5x3 + row/fly accessory
notes: Heavy horizontal press day (R1, R3). Bench press was a main movement in the spreadsheet's Sheet3 reference table but never made it into the rebooted pool. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Strict Press 5x5 + pull-up/skull crusher
notes: Vertical press main lift (Sheet3: strict press -> skull crushers). Small upper-body increments apply (R32: ~2-2.5% per progression step). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Push Press 5x3 + ring row/dip accessory
notes: Push press as a standalone main lift (Sheet3), triples at ~80% so leg drive and bar speed stay crisp (R5: 3-5 reps for derivatives). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Weighted Pull-up heavy 5x3 + bench/curl
notes: Heavy vertical pull day (R1, R3): the pull counterpart to the heavy bench day. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Bent Over Row 5x5 + press/goblet squat
notes: Horizontal pull as the main lift, 5x5 with 2.5 min rest (R3: 2-3 min at >=80%). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Deadlift 4x6 + Push Press 5x5 (mandatory day, volume)
notes: Volume variant of the mandatory deadlift + push press day (R26). Keep >=48 h from any other heavy hinge or overhead press; make the next day conditioning-only or rest. cadenceDays 6 so a mandatory-day variant is always eligible each week. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Deadlift 5x3 + Push Press 4x3 (mandatory day, heavy)
notes: Heavy variant of the mandatory day (R26): triples on both lifts, 4 min rest on the pull (R3). Next day lower intensity. cadenceDays 6. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Power Snatch EMOM + Back Squat 5x5

movements.loadNote: crisp, full extension; rest inside the minute

notes: R26 D1 template: oly pull first while fresh (R7, R24), 1-3 reps at 50-75% inside an EMOM (R9), then the heavy squat, then a short finisher. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Hang Clean 6x2 + Strict Press 5x5
notes: R26 D4 template: oly technique/power then press strength. Doubles at ~75% with 2.5 min rest (R5, R6), never to failure. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Clean + Jerk complex 8x(1+1)

movements.loadNote: 1 clean + 1 jerk per set, build to ~80%

notes: Classic-lift singles inside Prilepin's 70-90% band (R5: 8 total lifts at 80-90%), 3 min rest (R6). Sheet3 pairs jerk with dips and Turkish get-ups. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Snatch technique 8x2 + Overhead Squat 3x5

movements.loadNote: technique: speed under the bar, not load

notes: Sub-maximal snatch practice (R5/R8: 65% keeps technique intact) followed by overhead squat for receiving-position strength. Low intensity: this is a skill day. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Jumps (30 contacts) + Front Squat 5x3
notes: Plyometrics done fresh, first in the session (R23), 30 contacts inside R22's 20-80 recreational floor. Jumps are the only place box_jump appears in the pool; it never goes in a fatigued block (AUDIT.md finding 3). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Power Clean EMOM + Push Press 5x3
notes: Pull-then-press power day (R7, R9). Counts as heavy push for the pattern gate, so it sits >=48 h from the mandatory deadlift + push press day automatically (R21). Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Kettlebell power: heavy swings + snatch EMOM
notes: Ballistic hip power without a barbell: alternating EMOM keeps reps low and rest built in (R9 logic applied to kettlebell work). A diversity day per requirements.md.

name: Jerk 6x2 + Front Squat 4x5
notes: Jerk as its own main movement (Sheet3), doubles at ~80% with 3 min rest (R5, R6), then front squats for the rack position. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Speed Deadlift + jumps EMOM, Bench 4x5

movements.loadNote: speed pull, fast off the floor

notes: Dynamic-effort hinge: 60% pulls for bar speed alternated with broad jumps (24 contacts, R22/R23), then bench. Counts as heavy hinge for the pattern gate. Then 2-3 empty-bar / ramp-up sets of the main lift before the working sets (R24, R44).

name: Zone 2 Bike, 45 min
notes: Low-intensity continuous work is where most conditioning volume belongs (R15). First 5 min easy is the warm-up.

name: Zone 2 Run, 40 min
notes: Running interferes with strength more than cycling (R17), so keep this one truly easy and away from heavy squat days.

name: Zone 2 Row + Bike, 50 min
notes: Split-modality Zone 2 to spread the orthopedic load (R15).

name: The Slog: row / bike / run, 60 min
notes: The monthly long moderate effort (patterns_and_rules.md), kept at Zone 2 so it adds aerobic base rather than a third hard day (R15).

name: Norwegian 4x4 Row

movements.loadNote: easy, build to moderate in the last 2 min
90-95% HRmax; paddle easy for the 3 min recovery

notes: Helgerud's 4x4 protocol (R13): the best-evidenced VO2max session, 2-3x/wk max. Counts toward the ~20-40 min/wk of true high-intensity work (R15).

name: Norwegian 4x4 Run
notes: Running version of R13. Higher impact than the bike/row versions (R17), so not the day after heavy squats.

name: Billat 30/30 Bike

movements.loadNote: 30 s at vVO2max effort / 30 s easy spin

notes: R14: 30/30 accumulates time near VO2max at lower orthopedic cost than long intervals. Stop early if the 30 s work pace can no longer be held.

name: Billat 30/30 Row
notes: Rowing version of R14, 16 reps.

name: True Tabata Row

movements.loadNote: easy, two 10 s pick-ups at the end

notes: Single-movement 8x20/10 at supramaximal intensity (R12). Only 4 min of work; if it feels easy the intensity was wrong, not the duration.

name: Bike 6x2 min repeats
notes: 12 min of work at VO2max-ish intensity with equal recovery, between the 4x4 and 30/30 protocols in interval length (R13-R15).

name: Conditioning-priority day + upper accessory
notes: R26 D2: the conditioning-priority day of the 4-day split, with light upper accessory work and no heavy barbell so the mandatory day stays fresh.

name: Work-capacity chipper
notes: A mixed-modal for-time piece (R16): legitimate work-capacity training, deliberately without a heavy lift in front of it (R20).

name: Death by Burpees
notes: Progressive-rep anaerobic test (workout_formats.md). Short, no equipment beyond the cool-down bike.

name: Aerobic EMOM 30: row / bike / burpee

movements.loadNote: finish each minute with >=15 s rest

notes: Moderate steady work with built-in rest. R15 caps moderate "grey zone" volume, so use this instead of, not in addition to, a hard interval day that week.

name: Active recovery: easy bike + mobility
notes: The lower-intensity day R26 asks for after the mandatory deadlift + push press day. Nothing here counts as heavy loading for the pattern gate.

name: Active recovery: easy row + carries
notes: Blood flow and trunk work without loading the hinge/squat/press patterns (R21).

name: Recovery walk / jog, 30 min

movements.loadNote: walk or easy jog, conversational, Zone 1

notes: No-equipment recovery day. Keep it genuinely easy (R15, R17).

name: Deload: squat technique at 60%
notes: A deload-week session (R29, R41: volume -40-60%, intensity -10-20%). Also useful as the one-session 10% back-off after a stall (R33).

name: Deload: hinge technique, light RDL + swings
notes: Hinge-pattern deload session (R29, R41).

name: Deload: press + pull technique at 60%
notes: Upper-body deload session (R29, R41).

name: Core & stability diversity day
notes: requirements.md's technical/diversity day: stability muscles, no heavy barbell.

name: Unilateral diversity: pistols / single-leg RDL

movements.loadNote: pistol, lunge or side lunge - pick one per set

notes: Single-leg strength and balance (requirements.md diversity day); bodyweight rest intervals per R11.
